name: hud_layout_sw_register_at_exit
description: HudLayoutSW::RegisterAtExit registers the software HUD layout global destructor callback with the CRT at-exit table.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this CRT static-lifetime helper is deferred to the HUD layout source-cluster tier S pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x40d280 pushes the callback at 0x40d290, calls the accepted atexit provider, cleans the stack, and returns.

The native smoke exercises HudLayoutSW::RegisterAtExit after constructing g_HudLayoutSW and verifies the global remains in the constructed software layout state while the registered callback is safe at process exit.
